label: Absalon engineering: international qualifications and IB documents

milestones.label: Absalon: application documents; check individual missing-document requests
milestones.note: Submit available required documents with the application. The engineering FAQ gives a later process for unfinished exams; individual nemStudie requests control missing items.

milestones.label: Absalon: preliminary results if your exam finishes later
milestones.note: The engineering FAQ says to declare later completion and attach preliminary results plus expected subject-hours verification before this date if final evidence will arrive before 1 September. Same-year non-EU eligibility requires confirmation.

milestones.label: Absalon: accept by the deadline in your admission letter
milestones.note: No public 2027 reply date is stated. Follow the individual offer in nemStudie.

submissionItems.label: Qualifying exam certificate and transcript, or declared pending completion
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: optagelse.dk; monitor nemStudie for missing-document instructions

submissionItems.label: Preliminary results and expected subject-hours verification for later completion
submissionItems.note: IB exams are generally exempt from the ordinary subject-hours form, but the later-completion procedure explicitly requests expected-hours verification. Follow the admissions office’s individual instructions.

supplementarySteps: The application pages expressly allow EU summer finishers to state pending completion. The generic FAQ does not clearly settle same-year non-EU IB eligibility; confirm with admissions before relying on it.
Final IB results delivery method, recipient code and a specific 2027 final-result deadline are not published in the Absalon pages read.
Non-EU/EEA applicants normally pay DKK 3,750 before assessment after receiving payment instructions in nemStudie.

notes: Supplements the national route only for the two Absalon engineering opportunities. Annual dates are provisional for 2027.
